clips.text: That is why dreams cannot last longer than that in your memory after waking.
When the mind is approaching sleep it again passes the same threshold.
Be aware of this threshold because it is very significant for those who are in search of the inner treasure.
This threshold is the gate to the unknown.
This threshold, this gap between waking and sleep, must be used for meditation.
Be aware of the gap, be a witness of the interval, and you will be.transformed
